title: STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling
title_zh: STRIKE：学习视觉状态转换以实现物理世界建模

paragraphs.en: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 物理世界建模需要预测交互如何改变场景，而不仅仅是生成连贯的运动。 我们提出了 STRIKE，一个将视觉状态转换学习与密集视频生成分离的框架。 我们通过从训练视频中提取观测到的状态，并将其与转换描述和时间偏移配对，构建了对齐事件的发生监督信号。 一种基于图像的转换模型能够根据当前图像、局部转换说明以及经过的时间来预测下一个场景配置。 在推理阶段，一个预训练的视觉-语言规划器会预测时间转换说明，而通过递归应用所学到的转换模型，可以生成一系列未来的视觉状态序列。 随后，一个单独训练的动态模型会根据这些状态及其时间位置，生成完整的演化过程。 在 Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments 和 RoboTwin2.0 上的实验表明，与相应的视频主干基线模型相比，STRIKE 在物理一致性和操作视频保真度等基准指标上表现更优。 这些结果支持将学习到的视觉状态转换作为物理世界建模的有效中间表示。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in physical world modeling is predicting the consequences of interactions among objects and agents. For example, a successful grasp establishes attachment between an object and a gripper, while lift preserves that attachment and changes the object’s support conditions (Figure 1 ). We use visual states to denote configurations that express such interaction outcomes ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) . These states capture changes in object configurations and relations that constrain subsequent physical evolution. Preserving object appearance alone is therefore insufficient: the generated scene must also establish the relation of transition that make an interaction physically meaningful.
paragraphs.zh: 物理世界建模中的一个核心挑战是预测物体与智能体之间相互作用的后果。 例如，一次成功的抓取会在物体和夹具之间建立连接，而提起动作则会保持这种连接并改变物体的支撑条件（图 1）。 我们使用视觉状态来表示体现此类相互作用结果的配置（Zeng et al., 2024）。 这些状态捕捉了物体配置和关系中发生的变化，这些变化会限制其后续的物理演化。 因此，仅保留物体的外观是不够的：生成的场景还必须建立使相互作用具有物理意义的转换关系。

paragraphs.en: We consider a formulation that treats transitions between visual states as an explicit learning target. A state-transition model predicts the state reached after an interaction, given the current observation and an interaction specification. A conditional dynamics model then models how the scene evolves between the predicted states. For open-domain generation, a pretrained vision-language event planner provides the local transition specifications and their temporal locations. This formulation allows us to investigate whether explicitly learning state transitions improves the prediction of interaction outcomes and their subsequent physical consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们考虑一种将视觉状态之间的转换视为明确学习目标的表述方式。 状态转换模型在给定当前观察结果和交互规范时，能够预测交互后达到的状态。 随后，条件动态模型会模拟场景在预测状态之间如何演变。 对于开放域生成，一个预训练的视觉-语言事件规划器会提供局部转换规范及其时间位置。 这种表述方式使我们能够研究：明确学习状态转换是否有助于提升对交互结果及其后续物理后果的预测能力。

paragraphs.en: Learning state transitions is a general approach to predictive modeling for planning and control. Latent dynamics models support planning and behavior learning ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ) , visual prediction supports robot manipulation ( Ebert et al., 2018 ) , and language-conditioned video models represent task execution through visual plans ( Du et al., 2023 ) . Within this broader setting, we study a transition interface defined by the current image, a local description of a physical change, and elapsed time. Our focus is on learning this mapping from event-aligned state pairs and composing its predictions to guide dense visual evolution.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose STRIKE, a novel framework that explicitly learns visual state transitions and uses the predicted states to condition dense video generation. We first instantiate the state-transition model as a conditional image model that predicts a future visual state from the current observation, an interaction specification, and the elapsed time. To construct its supervision, a VLM-assisted curation pipeline identifies events in training videos, selects informative visual states, and annotates the transitions between them. After structural and quality checks, adjacent selected states are paired with transition descriptions and elapsed times, yielding supervision grounded in observed changes rather than generic video-level captions. The selected images are extracted from training videos rather than synthesized by the annotator. We train the image model on these pairs, directly supervising how a specified interaction changes the scene’s object configurations and relations. During inference, the event planner instead predicts future transition conditions from the initial image and task context, without observing future reference frames. Each predicted state becomes the input for the next specified interaction, allowing the model to construct a sequence of successive visual states. These predictions provide explicit state and timing conditions for dense video generation. Second, the conditional dynamics model is implemented as a video diffusion model trained to generate the motion and intermediate configurations connecting these states. Together, the two components model physical evolution through explicit interaction outcomes and the dynamics between them.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 STRIKE——一种新颖的框架，它能显式学习视觉状态转换，并利用预测出的状态为密集视频生成提供条件。 我们首先将状态转换模型具体化为一个条件图像模型，该模型根据当前观察结果、交互规范以及已过去的时间来预测未来的视觉状态。 为了构建其监督信号，一条由 VLM 辅助的整理流程会识别训练视频中的事件，选择具有信息量的视觉状态，并标注它们之间的转换关系。 经过结构和质量检查后，相邻的选定状态会与转换描述及已过去的时间配对，从而生成基于实际观察变化而非通用视频级标题的监督信号。 这些选定的图像是从训练视频中提取的，而非由标注者合成。 我们使用这些配对数据训练图像模型，直接监督指定的交互如何改变场景中物体的配置和关系。 在推理阶段，事件规划器则根据初始图像和任务上下文预测未来的转换条件，而无需观察未来的参考帧。 每个预测出的状态都会成为下一次指定交互的输入，使模型能够构建出一系列连续的视觉状态序列。 这些预测为密集视频生成提供了明确的状态和时间条件。 其次，条件动态模型被实现为一个视频扩散模型，经过训练以生成连接这些状态的动态过程和中间配置。 这两个组件共同建模了物理演化过程，通过显式的交互结果以及它们之间的动态变化来体现。

paragraphs.en: We formulate visual state-transition prediction as an explicit event- and time-conditioned learning task, and construct event-aligned supervision from observed video states through a VLM-assisted annotation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将视觉状态转移预测表述为一个显式的、以事件和时间为条件的学习任务，并通过一个由VLM辅助的标注流程，从观测到的视频状态中构建与事件对齐的监督信号。

paragraphs.en: We develop a compositional generation framework that combines timed event planning with recursive prediction of transition states. These states and their temporal locations provide soft conditions for separately trained video dynamics models, instantiated with CogVideoX and Wan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种组合式生成框架，它将定时事件规划与过渡状态的递归预测相结合。 这些状态及其时间位置为分别训练的动态视频模型提供了软性约束条件，具体实例包括 CogVideoX 和 Wan。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video generators, including CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , Wan ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , and Cosmos ( Ali et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2026a ) , provide backbones for visual world modeling. IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) aligns action trajectories with video frames, while Unified World Models ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) jointly models video and action diffusion for dynamics and policy learning. Complementary approaches target physical fidelity through physics-aware conditioning ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , simulation-based post-training ( Li et al., 2025a ) , relational alignment ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , latent motion priors ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and staged motion control ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . These approaches primarily address video-level generation or control; we focus on explicitly predicting the outcomes of individual interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成模型，包括 CogVideoX（Yang 等人，2025b）、Wan（Wan 等人，2025）和 Cosmos（Ali 等人，2025；NVIDIA，2026a），为视觉世界建模提供了基础框架。 IRASim（Zhu 等人，2025b）将动作轨迹与视频帧对齐，而统一世界模型（Zhu 等人，2025a）则联合建模视频和动作扩散，以实现动力学和政策学习。 互补的方法通过物理感知条件约束（Wang 等人，2025a）、基于模拟的后训练（Li 等人，2025a）、关系对齐（Zhang 等人，2025）、潜在运动先验（Jiang 等人，2026）和分阶段运动控制（Xu 等人，2026）来追求物理真实性。 这些方法主要解决视频级别的生成或控制问题；我们则专注于明确预测单个交互的结果。

paragraphs.en: KeyWorld ( Li et al., 2025b ) generates task-relevant keyframes from an initial observation and a global task description before reconstructing dense video. SKIP ( He et al., 2026 ) learns event-preserving sparse rollouts with interpolation. DCARL ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) trains a keyframe generator to establish consistent structural anchors for long trajectory generation. RoboEnvision ( Yang et al., 2025a ) decomposes manipulation tasks into atomic instructions, generates aligned boundary keyframes, and fills the intervening segments conditioned on those instructions. CausalMotion ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) uses VLM-planned keyframes and object trajectories to guide a pretrained video generator without additional training, while CoECT ( Wang et al., 2026 ) constructs event keyframes through event-chain reasoning and iterative editing. We instead directly supervise a shared transition model on event-aligned state pairs, conditioned on the current visual state, one interaction specification, and elapsed time.

paragraphs.en: Data annotation. For each training video \symbfit ​ V \symbfit{V} and its caption \symbfit ​ c \symbfit{c} , we sample candidate frames and construct a storyboard labeled with frame indices and timestamps. sents.en: The model generates the full video window jointly, allowing motion between two states to depend on the wider sequence of predicted outcomes, rather than synthesizing each interval independently.
sents.zh: 该模型联合生成整个视频窗口，使得两个状态之间的运动可以依赖更广泛的预测结果序列，而不是独立合成每个区间。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our proposed system on Physics-IQ Verified ( Rädsch et al., 2026 ; Motamed et al., 2026 ) , PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) , PISA Experiments ( Li et al., 2025a ) , and our held-out RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) split discussed in Section A.1 . Physics-IQ Verified evaluates whether generated videos exhibit realistic physical dynamics across phenomena such as gravity, collisions, fluids, materials, lighting, and magnetism. PhyGenBench tests physical commonsense across 27 laws spanning mechanics, optics, thermal phenomena, and material properties, assessing key events, temporal order, and overall naturalness. PISA Experiments focuses on object-dropping scenarios in real and simulated environments, measuring whether generated object trajectories and interactions align with expected physical motion. To evaluate the results of Robotwin2.0 validation against baselines, we apply the EWMScore, a 15-metric adaptation of WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) , with more details provided in Section A.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Physics-IQ Verified（Rädsch 等人，2026；Motamed 等人，2026）、PhyGenBench（Meng 等人，2025）、PISA Experiments（Li 等人，2025a）以及我们在 A.1 节中讨论的预留 RoboTwin 2.0（Chen 等人，2025）数据集上评估了我们提出的系统。 Physics-IQ Verified 用于评估生成的视频是否在重力、碰撞、流体、材料、光照和磁性等现象中展现出逼真的物理动态。 PhyGenBench 通过涵盖力学、光学、热现象和材料性质的 27 条定律来测试物理常识，并评估关键事件、时间顺序以及整体自然性。 PISA Experiments 聚焦于真实与模拟环境中的物体掉落场景，测量生成的物体轨迹和相互作用是否符合预期的物理运动规律。 为了将 Robotwin2.0 验证结果与基线模型进行比较，我们采用了 EWMScore——这是基于 WorldArena（Shang 等人，2026）改进的包含 15 项指标的评价体系，更多细节见 A.5 节。

paragraphs.en: Physics-IQ Verified. As shown in Table 1 , our method substantially improves physical consistency across both video backbones. It achieves scores of 41.9 with CogVideoX-5B and 39.7 with Wan2.2-5B, surpassing their respective baselines by 11.4 and 20.3 points. Both variants outperform all baselines with reported component metrics on ST-IoU and WS-IoU, with our CogVideoX-based variant reaching 53.5 and 36.0, respectively. Although Wan2.2-14B retains the highest S-IoU, our variants achieve higher overall scores, highlighting improvements beyond spatial agreement alone. Our best variant also surpasses MiniMax-H3 and is only 0.8 points behind Cosmos3-Super. These results demonstrate that augmenting a 5B video backbone with our 20B auxiliary model provides a competitive alternative to increasing the video generator’s scale.

paragraphs.en: Robotic Manipulation. On RoboTwin2 val500, comprising 500 held-out episodes across 50 tasks and five embodiments under an episode/seed-grouped split, both variants outperform all baselines on every displayed metric (Table 4 & Figure 5 ). Relative to their respective backbone baselines, our CogVideoX and Wan variants improve EWMScore-15 by 2.47 and 3.37 points, with trajectory-score gains of 43.7% and 42.0%. The Wan variant additionally improves interaction quality and instruction following by 18.2% and 31.8%, reaching 62.53 EWMScore-15. These consistent cross-backbone gains support explicit key-state conditioning for improving trajectory fidelity and task-aligned object interactions in generated manipulation videos.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人操控。 在 RoboTwin2 val500 数据集上，该数据集包含 50 个任务、五种实体形态以及通过“每集/种子分组”划分出的 500 个预留集，两种变体在所有展示指标（表 4 和图 5）上均优于所有基线模型。 相较于各自的基础模型基线，我们的 CogVideoX 和 Wan 变体将 EWMScore-15 提升了 2.47 和 3.37 分，轨迹得分分别提升了 43.7% 和 42.0%。 Wan 变体还进一步将交互质量和指令遵循能力提升了 18.2% 和 31.8%，使 EWMScore-15 达到 62.53。 这些跨基础模型的一致性提升表明，通过显式的关键状态条件约束，能够有效提高生成操控视频中轨迹的保真度以及任务相关的物体交互质量。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. Figure 4 compares our method with the baselines on two Physics-IQ Verified examples. In the mug-drop example, our method captures impact followed by fragmentation, whereas the baselines retain an intact mug or leave it suspended above the concrete block. In the ball–duck example, our sequence depicts the ball approaching the duck, making contact, and inducing displacement. The baselines instead exhibit inconsistent ball motion, missing interactions, or spurious changes to the pipe. By providing explicit intermediate states at planned event times, our method guides video generation toward the intended physical progression.

paragraphs.en: We compare pretrained Qwen-Image-Edit (QIE) with our trained transition model through the event-planning and transition-state generation pipeline (Figure 6 ; Table 6 ). Metrics are computed against reference states, excluding the initial input image. On validation states, PSNR increases from 17.90 to 24.88 and SSIM from 0.674 to 0.863, while LPIPS and L1 decrease by 57.6% and 63.5%, respectively. Both perceptual similarity and pixel-level accuracy improve. These gains accompany improvements in downstream video generation: Physics-IQ rises from 32.60 to 41.93, PhyGenBench from 72.50 to 76.91, and Pisa-IoU from 0.1224 to 0.1753. Together, these results support learning task-specific transitions and using their predicted states to condition dense video synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 examines first-frame anchoring, temporal conditioning, and synthetic data. Removing the first-frame anchor lowers Physics-IQ/Pisa-IoU to 40.60/0.1528, supporting persistent conditioning on the initial visual reference during recursive prediction. Without time conditioning, Physics-IQ decreases modestly to 41.63, whereas Pisa-IoU falls to 0.1617, indicating benchmark-dependent benefits. Excluding synthetic data yields 37.91/0.1523 and the largest Physics-IQ drop of 4.02 points. These comparisons favor retaining all three design choices, although differences in training mixtures and budgets limit strict causal attribution to individual components.

paragraphs.en: We presented a physical world modeling framework that explicitly learns visual state transitions and uses their timed predictions to condition dense video generation. VLM-assisted annotation constructs event-aligned supervision, while a pretrained event planner provides transition specifications for open-domain inference. Across physical-video and robotic manipulation benchmarks, the resulting intermediate-state representation improves physical-consistency and manipulation- video metrics over corresponding video backbones. However, the framework remains a learned visual predictor rather than an explicit physics simulator: plausible states do not guarantee correct trajectories, contact dynamics, or conservation laws. Since training uses observed states but inference conditions on recursively predicted states, errors may accumulate over long horizons. The pipeline also introduces additional planning and image-generation costs and depends on the quality of model-assisted annotations.

paragraphs.en: For robotic manipulation, we use 124,650 complete simulated episodes from RoboTwin2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , spanning 50 tasks and five robot embodiments: ALOHA-AgileX, ARX-X5, Franka, UR5, and Piper. This snapshot contains 11,150 clean and 113,500 domain-randomized episodes. We construct a deterministic 90/10 split into 112,185 training and 12,465 validation episodes, keeping episodes with the same task and simulation seed in the same split across embodiments and clean/randomized configurations. This prevents the same task–seed group from appearing on both sides. For the reported val500 evaluation, we select 500 held-out episodes covering all 50 tasks and all five embodiments; every selected episode is domain-randomized. Thus, the evaluation measures generalization to unseen episodes of known tasks, not to held-out task categories.
paragraphs.zh: 在机器人操作任务中，我们使用了来自 RoboTwin2.0（Chen 等人，2025）的 124,650 个完整的模拟片段，涵盖 50 项任务和五种机器人形态：ALOHA-AgileX、ARX-X5、Franka、UR5 和 Piper。 该快照包含 11,150 个干净片段和 113,500 个经过领域随机化的片段。 我们构建了一个确定性的 90/10 划分，将片段分为 112,185 个训练片段和 12,465 个验证片段，并确保相同任务和模拟种子的片段在不同机器人形态以及干净/随机化配置中始终属于同一划分。 这样可以避免同一任务–种子组合同时出现在训练集和验证集中。 对于所报告的 val500 评估，我们选择了 500 个保留片段，覆盖全部 50 项任务和五种机器人形态；每个被选中的片段都经过了领域随机化。 因此，该评估衡量的是模型对已知任务中未见过片段的泛化能力，而非对保留的任务类别的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: We construct transition state frame annotations through a two-stage vision–language model (VLM) annotation pipeline, followed by VQA-based verification. For each video, candidate frames are arranged into a temporally ordered storyboard and provided alongside the video caption, available source metadata, and a candidate table specifying frame identifiers and timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一个两阶段视觉-语言模型（VLM）标注流程构建过渡态帧的标注，随后进行基于 VQA 的验证。 对于每个视频，候选帧会被排列成一个按时间顺序组织的故事板，并与视频字幕、可用的源元数据以及指定了帧标识符和时间戳的候选表一同提供。

paragraphs.en: In (Table 8 ), the annotator identifies the main objects and physical or visual process, characterizes the event structure, and decomposes the observed progression into a minimal sequence of visible subevents. It then constructs a state plan grounded in candidate frames, prioritizing physical state changes while also allowing camera motion that reveals new content or distinct viewpoints. Clips without useful visible state or view progression are flagged as unsuitable for event-based annotation.

paragraphs.en: In (Table 10 ), the annotator uses this event plan to select a compact, chronologically ordered set of event-defining transition state frames, rather than generic beginning–middle–end coverage. paragraphs.en: In (Table 11 ) uses Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as a separate VQA judge to assess whether each annotated state is supported by the visual evidence. paragraphs.en: For transition model, we fine-tune Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) as a time-conditioned Markov model using paired examples from the comprehensive multi-source training corpus. Each example consists of the previous ground-truth state image, the next state image, and a text instruction describing their transition. Images are encoded with a frozen VAE, while the frozen vision-language encoder processes the instruction and conditioning image. The transformer receives concatenated noisy target latents and clean source latents. Relative transition state frame timing is represented through temporal rotary positional embeddings, assigning positions zero and ( Δ ​ t \Delta t ) to source and target tokens, respectively. We optimize a flow-matching MSE objective on target tokens only, keeping the source image uncorrupted. The complete transformer is fine-tuned with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) at a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , using 100 warm-up steps. During auto-regressive inference, each generated transition state images becomes the semantic condition for the next transition. For conditional dynamic model training, we fine-tune CogVideoX-5B-I2V ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan Team, 2025 ) using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with learning rate equals to 10 − 5 10^{-5} and weight decay 0.01, keeping the VAE and text encoder frozen. Transition states latents are patchified using the pretrained projection, and temporally aligned with video tokens. The tokens are prepended with video stream for joint text–frame–video attention. Only video outputs are supervised, using velocity prediction for CogVideoX and flow matching for Wan. The transition model is trained with 64 A100 GPUs for 5 epochs with per-GPU batch size of 1 and the conditional dynamics model is trained with 32 GPUs for 5000 steps with per-GPU batch size of 2.
paragraphs.zh: 对于迁移模型，我们使用来自全面多源训练语料库的成对示例，将 Qwen-Image-Edit（Wu 等人，2025）微调为一个时间条件马尔可夫模型。 每个示例包括前一个真实状态图像、下一个状态图像以及描述它们之间转换的文本指令。 图像通过冻结的 VAE 进行编码，而冻结的视觉-语言编码器则处理指令和条件图像。 该变换器接收拼接后的含噪目标潜在变量和干净的源潜在变量。 相对转换状态帧的时间通过时间旋转位置嵌入来表示，分别将位置零和（Δt）分配给源和目标的标记。 我们仅对目标标记优化流匹配的 MSE 目标函数，同时保持源图像不受破坏。 整个变换器使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）进行微调，学习率为 10⁻⁵，并采用 100 个预热步骤。 在自回归推理过程中，每个生成的转换状态图像都会成为下一次转换的语义条件。 对于条件动态模型的训练，我们使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）对 CogVideoX-5B-I2V（Yang 等人，2025b）和 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B（Wan Team，2025）进行微调，学习率设为 10⁻⁵，权重衰减为 0.01，同时保持 VAE 和文本编码器冻结。 转换状态的潜在变量通过预训练的投影进行分块处理，并与视频标记在时间上对齐。 这些标记的前端会添加视频流，以实现联合的文本–帧–视频注意力机制。 仅对视频输出进行监督：CogVideoX 使用速度预测，Wan 则使用流匹配。 迁移模型使用 64 块 A100 GPU 训练 5 个周期，每块 GPU 的批量大小为 1；条件动态模型则使用 32 块 GPU 训练 5000 步，每块 GPU 的批量大小为 2。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate robotic manipulation videos using a 15-metric adaptation of WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) , denoted EWMScore-15. The retained metrics cover visual quality (image quality, aesthetic quality, and JEPA similarity), motion quality (dynamic degree, flow score, and motion smoothness), content consistency (subject, background, and photometric consistency), physics adherence (interaction quality and trajectory accuracy), 3D accuracy (depth accuracy and perspectivity), and controllability (instruction following and semantic alignment). We exclude Action Following, which requires generating videos under multiple alternative instructions from the same initial frame and is outside our single-instruction evaluation protocol. Using the evaluator’s metric-specific normalization and aggregation rules, we obtain dataset-level scores s j ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s_{j}\in[0,1] , with higher values indicating better performance, and compute EWMScore ​ - ​ 15 = 100 15 ​ ∑ j = 1 15 s j \mathrm{EWMScore\text{-}15}=\frac{100}{15}\sum_{j=1}^{15}s_{j} . All retained metrics receive equal weight. JEPA similarity is evaluated over the complete generated and reference video collections rather than averaged over individual episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 WorldArena（Shang 等人，2026）的 15 项指标改编版本（称为 EWMScore-15）来评估机器人操作视频。 保留的指标涵盖视觉质量（图像质量、美学质量和 JEPA 相似性）、运动质量（动态程度、流分数和运动平滑度）、内容一致性（主体、背景和光度一致性）、物理规律遵循性（交互质量和轨迹准确性）、3D 准确性（深度准确度和透视性）以及可控性（指令遵循和语义对齐）。 我们排除了“动作遵循”这一指标，因为它要求基于同一初始帧生成多种替代指令下的视频，这超出了我们的单指令评估协议范围。 通过采用评估器针对各指标制定的归一化和聚合规则，我们得到数据集级别的分数 s_j ∈ [0, 1]，其中数值越高表示性能越好，并计算得出 EWMScore-15 = (100/15) × Σ_{j=1}^{15} s_j。 所有保留的指标均赋予相等的权重。 JEPA 相似性是在完整的生成视频和参考视频集合上进行评估的，而非对单个片段取平均值。

paragraphs.en: Table 12 and table 9 demonstrate additional quantitative results on PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) and VideoPhy ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) , another benchmark that evaluates physical common-sence. Compared with other baseline methods, our method uses a substantially larger transition model (20B) together with only a lightweight 2B video backbone, yet remains competitive with, and often surpasses, baselines using 11–16B video models. Since the 2B version of CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2024 ) doesn’t have an image-to-video (I2V) branch, our results are reported with text-to-video (T2V) setting. On PhyGenBench ( Meng et al., 2025 ) , it achieves the second-best average score (65.68) and the best Material score (66.04). On VideoPhy ( Bansal et al., 2025 ) , it obtains the best overall physical common-sense precision (32.9), the best Fluid–Fluid precision (69.1), and competitive overall semantic accuracy (70.4), while using a lightweight 2B video generator.
